about_the_game:
The MegaCorp has become an oppressive force reaching out over the whole of your homeland, everything is owned or controlled by them. The only thing in it's way is you and your creator, the genius engineer Wheat Willy.

Play as the AI that controls a mixed bag of robot parts shoved together, find weapons and a variety of upgrade chips to improve yourself for the challenges that await you on the fight to the headquarters of the MegaCorp. If you lose your bot you lose connection and need to restart from the beginning all over again. Mix and match your loadout, your body parts to find the best combination for your playstyle. 

The MegaCorp isn't without its defenses, an endless army of enemy bots straight off the assembly line, and a number of District Controllers that will really give you a challenge.

Control yourself in an isometric twin stick shooter, with bullets flying everywhere, keep your head screwed on to stay alive.

short_description: With a pair of guns, a scattering of upgrade chips, you gotta take down the oppressive MegaCorp through this action packed roguelike. Take a trip through various levels, working your way all the way to the top of the Corporate ladder to finish the job.
